_: Skills of the core root that the main agent does not get (federal step 610-4, 2026-10-30). The files stay; scripts/main-agent-install.mjs writes them as skillOverrides: off into .claude/settings.local.json of the core root. Each one is a mechanism of the previous line or the job of an element.

off.build-product-with-owner: mode cases of the previous starter line
off.use-use-cases: mode cases of the previous starter line
off.use-telegram: Telegram Desk product of the previous line; the node's Telegram is the agent kit
off.use-channels: channels service :3500 of the previous line
off.use-map: geo service :3400 of the previous line
off.use-agentic-rag: LightRAG service of the previous line; the graph is the graph element
off.use-dynamic-workflows: waves of agents; subagents are forbidden
off.find-skills: installs skills globally; foreign skills go into the project with SOURCE.md
off.skill-creator: only a sample for writing a skill; its runs are forbidden
off.handle-block-request: the Blocks element does it; the main agent has blocks-of-the-node
off.explain-this-project: answered by this instruction and npm run contacts / card
off.use-auth-providers: the auth element owns sign-in providers
off.use-design: the Design element owns the look; the main agent has design-and-settings-of-elements
